lines.zh: 翅膀在洞穴里轻轻扇动。
lines.en: My wings beat softly in the cave.

lines.zh: 我小小的，谁都不会注意。
lines.en: I'm so small that no one notices.
I flit past the stalactites.
My grubs are all around me.
I circle the stone wall once.

lines.zh: 这里黑得几乎看不见我。
lines.en: It's dark enough to nearly hide me.

lines.zh: 我飞过一片湿漉漉的苔。
lines.en: I fly over a patch of wet moss.
A film of moisture clings to my wings.
I skim slowly along the cave floor.

lines.zh: 一阵穿堂风推了我一下。
lines.en: A draft through the tunnel shoves me.
Light and shadow alternate as I drift.
I fly deeper into the cave.

lines.zh: 我绕过一根断掉的石柱。
lines.en: I go around a broken stone pillar.
The grubs below shift along with me.
I make no sound but my wings.
I keep flying inside the shadows.
I settle on a stone in the ceiling.
The grubs squirm slowly below.
My eyes are dim.
Don't stare at me; I can't see you well.
My wings fold up slowly.

lines.zh: 洞里一直有滴水的声音。
lines.en: There's always dripping in here.
I hear someone breathing.
I shake out my tiny legs.
At any draft, I press to the wall.
It's too dark here — perfect.
No hurry; I'll simply wait.
Your heartbeat echoes in the cave.
Found me? Not easy.
I'm only a thumb's width.
Can you see my eyes?
Take the torch further off; it stings.
I cling to the stone and don't move.
Without looking down you'd miss me.
I'm right above your head now.
Your breath pushes me off balance.
I do love watching people.
You are nearly asleep on your feet.
One wing has been scraped open.
I fly crooked and clip a stalactite.
Even someone this small gets hit.
I drop to the ground and rise again.
One antenna snapped by the stone.
The pain flips me over in midair.
I shrink into a stone crack.
That was thoroughly unfair.
My grubs scattered everywhere.
I can still get airborne.
That bright thing is blinding.
I won't eat a bite of that.
I'm only interested in your body.
Reach out and I'll dart away.
The warmth off you feels lovely.
Stand there a while longer; don't leave yet.
Your scent is thick and heavy.

lines.zh: 我沿着你的热绕了一圈。
lines.en: I trail a circle around your warmth.

lines.zh: 你看手的时候我在这边。
lines.en: While you check your hand, I'm over here.
Leave it; I have no use for it.

lines.zh: 你撞到的是空气，也是我。
lines.en: You hit empty air — that was me.
I tumbled twice from that.
A wing bent — it's fine.
Your fingers brushed against me.
I'm on the back of your neck now.
Don't swing; you'll hit the wall.
I'm small, and very light.
You won't pin down where I am.
I back away into the shadow.
Even a graze counts.
I hadn't planned on that anyway.
My eggs are all over this cave.
Stay back; your fire's too bright.
We both hide in the dark.
Waiting for prey together is fine.
There's no need for closeness between us.
The grubs will keep watch for us.
Put out your torch first.
I'll cling to the wall and wait.
As things stand, this is good enough.
A small scrap of rotten flesh — enough.
I lay my eggs on it.
This can line the floor.
What you dropped is very light.
Holding it, I can't fly high.
I picked it up and studied it.
No use — dropped right there.
This stone is round — nice.
I drag it into the crack.
It fell, and I got here first.
Your nape is right below me.
You're easiest when you lie down.
I've seen your eyes.
Let the dark spread first.
The more tired you are, the easier you are.

lines.zh: 我不需要快，我只需要暗。
lines.en: I don't need speed — only darkness.

lines.zh: 你转身的时候我飞开了。
lines.en: As you turned, I flew off.
My grubs are all over this ground.
You'll want to sleep very soon.
I've settled behind your back.
Don't be afraid; I bring no pain.
First, let your eyes fail.
I hug close and circle you once.
I've landed on your shoulder.
You're walking into the dark.
My grubs wait for you to miss a step.
The torch in your hand is dimming.
I press close to your ear.
You're blinking less often.
I'm only three inches from you.
There's no light of an exit here.
Your steps have started to sway.
Let your knees go soft.
I see your eyes have closed.
I bit the back of your neck.
A little bite is already enough.
I blow darkness into your eyes.
You can't reach me at all.
My grubs climb up your boots.
You stumble back a step.
I bite you once more.
You're swinging at empty air.
You're starting to dream, aren't you?
I land on the nape of your neck.
I squeeze out of a crack in the stone.
The cave floor is cold and wet.
Grubs spread out beneath me.
My wings are still new.
The dark here is just right.
I hear people talking above.
I cling to the ceiling and wait.
There isn't a bit of light.
I open my eyes slowly.
I know the cracks in this stone wall.
Fire near me scorches my wings.
I fell from the cave ceiling.
Water swallows me whole.
The blast slams me into the wall.
An arrow pins me to the stone.

lines.zh: 那光刺得我什么也看不见。
lines.en: That light blinds me completely.
Hunger makes my flight unsteady.

lines.zh: 一道电光把洞照得雪白。
lines.en: A flash turns the cave snow-white.
The bottomless dark is hollow.
